semanticModels: not used by V10; retained only for the legacy V9 page
architecture: V10 WebXR geometry workflow: scan -> model -> frame-quality. WebXR is requested immediately and remains the metric backbone; automatic keyframes are fused only after affine metric alignment against WebXR anchors. Depth Anything is smoke-tested at startup: Q4F16 runs on WebGPU, while the separately pinned Q4 model is the real WASM fallback. Every user-saved photograph first receives a visible relative-depth preview and contributes RGB-colored surfels only after the user confirms it; rejected or declined frames leave the WebXR map unchanged. A V10 RAW room ZIP preserves the verified colored surfel cloud, WebXR poses/depth frames, raw XR geometry, and lossless RGBA user photographs so the room can be reopened and its Depth Anything previews reprocessed without a new AR session. SAM is not loaded or used by V10. Audio remains available only in the legacy V9 workflow.
patch: V10.0.9: WebXR is requested immediately so AI loading cannot expire the user gesture. Depth Anything uses Q4F16 on WebGPU and the separately verified Q4 model on WASM; both paths are checksum-pinned and the startup smoke inference reports provider and variant.
